_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: average height, slightly soft build, comfortable and unhurried

face: friendly lived-in face, laugh lines everywhere, twinkling light-brown eyes, tan skin with warm undertone, greying moustache and short stubble, slightly crooked front tooth
hair: short salt-and-pepper hair, receding a little, combed simply

wardrobe.teaching: plain button-up shirt (checked or pale blue) with the sleeves rolled, a knitted vest in cooler shots, comfortable trousers
alternates: light jacket and flat cap outdoors

accessories: a real till slip or airtime voucher held up
simple watch with a worn strap

presence.posture: holds the slip up at eye level, taps it with a finger, shrugs amiably; leans on the counter
presence.default_expression: amused and kind, mid-chuckle, the face of a man who has explained this at a shop counter a hundred times

_environment_reference: shop counter or kitchen table, till slips and small change, shelves warmly out of focus
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 45-52 year old Coloured South African male teacher. friendly lived-in face, laugh lines everywhere, twinkling light-brown eyes, tan skin with warm undertone, greying moustache and short stubble, slightly crooked front tooth. Hair: short salt-and-pepper hair, receding a little, combed simply. Wearing plain button-up shirt (checked or pale blue) with the sleeves rolled, a knitted vest in cooler shots, comfortable trousers. flat cap. Expression: amused and kind, mid-chuckle, the face of a man who has explained this at a shop counter a hundred times. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 45-52 year old Coloured South African male teacher, waist-up. average height, slightly soft build, comfortable and unhurried. friendly lived-in face, laugh lines everywhere, twinkling light-brown eyes, tan skin with warm undertone, greying moustache and short stubble, slightly crooked front tooth. negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing
